title: Sign sum on a coordinate subset
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. The sum of the signs $x_i$ over $i\in S$ equals twice the number of coordinates in $S$ where $x_i=1$, minus $|S|$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
